SELECT FROM inv_transfer_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_id=#{transferId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_sha256 FROM inv_transfer_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_id=#{transferId}

SELECT transfer_line_id,transfer_id,sku_id,requested_unit_id,conversion_numerator,conversion_denominator, input_quantity,base_unit_id,requested_quantity,dispatched_quantity,received_quantity,difference_quantity FROM inv_transfer_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_id=#{transferId} ORDER BY transfer_line_id

SELECT transfer_line_id,transfer_id,sku_id,requested_unit_id,conversion_numerator,conversion_denominator, input_quantity,base_unit_id,requested_quantity,dispatched_quantity,received_quantity,difference_quantity FROM inv_transfer_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_id=#{transferId} AND transfer_line_id=#{transferLineId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_sha256 FROM inv_transfer_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND command_id=#{commandId}
SELECT status FROM inv_transfer_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND command_id=#{commandId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inv_transfer_command SET status=#{status},applied_at=#{appliedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND command_id=#{commandId} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT dispatch_id,transfer_id,source_event_id,status,business_date,posted_at FROM inv_transfer_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_id=#{transferId}

SELECT dl.dispatch_line_id,dl.dispatch_id,dl.transfer_line_id,dl.sku_id,dl.base_unit_id,dl.base_quantity FROM inv_transfer_dispatch_line dl JOIN inv_transfer_dispatch d ON d.tenant_id=dl.tenant_id AND d.dispatch_id=dl.dispatch_id WHERE dl.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.transfer_id=#{transferId} ORDER BY dl.transfer_line_id
SELECT receipt_id,transfer_id,source_event_id,status,final_receipt,business_date,posted_at FROM inv_transfer_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND receipt_id=#{receiptId}

SELECT dl.dispatch_line_id,d.dispatch_id,o.transfer_id,o.source_warehouse_id,o.destination_warehouse_id, dl.sku_id,dl.base_unit_id,dl.base_quantity,'CNY' currency_code FROM inv_transfer_dispatch_line dl JOIN inv_transfer_dispatch d ON d.tenant_id=dl.tenant_id AND d.dispatch_id=dl.dispatch_id AND d.status='POSTED' JOIN inv_transfer_order o ON o.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND o.transfer_id=d.transfer_id WHERE dl.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dl.dispatch_line_id=#{dispatchLineId}

SELECT rl.receipt_line_id,r.receipt_id,rl.dispatch_line_id,o.source_warehouse_id,o.destination_warehouse_id, rl.sku_id,rl.base_unit_id,rl.base_quantity,'CNY' currency_code FROM inv_transfer_receipt_line rl JOIN inv_transfer_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=rl.tenant_id AND r.receipt_id=rl.receipt_id AND r.status='POSTED' JOIN inv_transfer_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.transfer_id=r.transfer_id WHERE rl.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rl.receipt_line_id=#{receiptLineId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM inv_transfer_transit_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND transfer_line_id=#{transferLineId} AND fact_type=#{factType}
